item.title: Master the 5-Line Cover Letter 🖊️ • Line 1: State your interest and the role. • Line 2: Mention one key achievement. • Line 3: Connect achievement to the role. • Line 4: Highlight a soft skill. • Line 5: Express eagerness to discuss further. How can you make your cover letter punchy and to the point? #coverletter #jobapplication #ScalePilot #SocialPilot #AIAutomations
